newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dae Han Pulp shrs fall on telecom news.
newsitem.headline: Dae Han Pulp shrs fall on telecom news.

text.p: Shares in South Korea's Dae Han Pulp Co Ltd went limit down in Monday's afternoon trading on the news that it would drop its plans to enter the wireless data communications business, brokers said.
The shares fell 3,700 won to their lower limit of 59,300.

The shares fell sharply after the Korea Stock Exchange announced that the company would give up its telecom ambition due to uncertain business prospects and difficulties getting the necessary approvals to launch the business.
Local brokers said stock in Dae Han Pulp had been rising since it announced the plan earlier this year.
